sector_model: Midstream compression services (energy infrastructure, small to mid): utilization, contract backlog, growth versus maintenance capex, leverage and dividend coverage; not a generic screen.
thesis: Kodiak Gas Services (NYSE: KGS), Q3 2026 10-Q filed 2026-11-09 (statements read, MD&A not in extraction). Q3 revenue 401.8M vs 322.7M (+24.5%), 9M 1,138.7M vs 975.2M (+16.8%); Q3 operating income 138.5M vs 64.2M; Q3 net income 71.5M vs a 14.2M loss (the prior quarter had a 38.2M asset-sale loss; Q3 2026 asset-sale loss 2.0M; interest expense 47.4M vs 56.4M); 9M NI 141.3M includes a 36.5M debt extinguishment loss. TTM revenue 1,471.5M, NI 165.9M. Close 42.67 (2026-11-16, ex-dividend day) and 101.38M shares: market cap 4,326M = 26.1x TTM NI. Capex 544.3M in 9M26 versus OCF 366.9M gives negative 9M FCF of 177.4M and TTM FCF of negative 35.3M (yield -0.8%), while dividends paid were 142.7M (0.49 quarterly; yield about 4.6% on 1.96 annualized). Long-term debt 2,760.5M (2,555.3M at year end), cash 86.9M. The growth is capital funded; the price assumes new horsepower earns contracted returns above the cost of the debt. Run 67 update from the earnings release: Q3 Adjusted EBITDA 224.5M (55.9% margin), discretionary cash flow 158.5M, Q3 OCF 196.3M, Q3 FCF -28.1M; 2026 guidance Adjusted EBITDA 840M to 860M, discretionary cash flow 580M to 600M, maintenance capex 80M to 90M, growth capex 640M to 710M (compression 290M to 310M, power 350M to 400M); compression utilization 98.3% on 4,592,143 hp, power 92.5% on 413 MW; credit agreement leverage 3.1x; ABL availability 1.6B. Dividend declared 0.51 (+4.1%, correcting the 0.49 used above; yield about 4.8% on 2.04 annualized). Backlog not disclosed. Net debt about 2.7B over guided EBITDA 850M midpoint is about 3.2x (derived).
counterthesis: Dividends and growth capex exceed operating cash flow, so the gap is funded with debt (net debt about 2.7B, roughly 4.8x TTM OCF, EBITDA not read). Q3 profit growth partly reflects a smaller asset-sale loss and lower interest, not only operations. Compression is capital intensive, contract renewals and natural gas activity are cyclical, and utilization, backlog, customer concentration and covenants were not read. Insiders filed Forms 4 and 144 in November; transactions unread.
invalidation: Thesis fails if utilization or contract pricing weakens, debt rises faster than EBITDA without capex slowing, or the dividend is cut to fund growth.
